mapper.select: SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND file_version = #{fileVersion}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE source_system = #{sourceSystem} AND business_date = #{businessDate} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM reconciliation_file_batch WHERE status = #{status} AND file_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_file_batch (file_id, batch_id, source_system, object_key, record_type, file_version, schema_version, business_date, window_start, window_end, cutoff_at, sha256, byte_size, record_count, actual_record_count, status, failure_reason, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{batchId}, #{sourceSystem}, #{objectKey}, #{recordType}, #{fileVersion}, #{schemaVersion}, #{businessDate}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{cutoffAt}, #{sha256}, #{byteSize}, #{recordCount}, #{actualRecordCount}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (source_system, object_key, file_version) DO NOTHING
